description: Antropico - Argini con geometria PolylineZ is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by datigis.comune.fi.it. The dataset contains:arginc: Argini with PolylineZ geometry (class argin, has two spatial components arginc with PolylineZ geometry and argins with PolygonZ geometry) In this class are defined the entities that represent the forms of retention and collection of water. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Anthropic - Argini with PolylineZ geometry" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include open data, antropico, celerimetrico, manufatti. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
